description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git reset' command with '--merge' and '--keep' options. It contains setup commands, test cases, and verification steps for different reset scenarios in a git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the given commands, and verifies expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail, and captures error output for verification.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates a time tick to create distinguishable commits.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if the specified file or directory is missing.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is an existing file.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Compares files or branches, optionally checking for differences.
